look.whale: enormous, the greatest of all that swim, shaped like the leaping grey one but vast
look.cow: large and heavy, four legs, a patched hide, horns, a deep lowing voice
look.sheep: round and woolly, four thin legs, bleats, eats the grass
look.pig: pink, stout, a flat snout, grunts, roots in the ground
look.horse: tall and swift, long legs, a mane and a long tail
look.donkey: like the swift tall one but smaller, with long ears and a loud bray
look.rabbit: small, long ears, hops, very quick
look.llama: tall with a long woolly neck, proud, sometimes spits
look.panda: big, round, black and white, sits and eats, rolls over
look.camel: very tall, a hump on its back, long legs, kneels to rest
look.armadillo: small, covered in hard plates, rolls into a ball
look.frog: small, wet skin, leaps, croaks, a long tongue
look.turtle: carries a round shell on its back, slow on land, graceful in water
look.chicken: a small bird that walks more than it flies, clucks, pecks at seeds
look.parrot: a bright bird of many colours that flies and copies sounds
look.bee: tiny, striped, hums, goes from flower to flower
look.cod: a plain brown fish that swims in shoals
look.salmon: a long red-sided fish, strong, leaps
look.tropical_fish: a small fish in bright colours and patterns
look.squid: soft, dark, many arms, squirts black ink
look.glow_squid: like the many-armed one, but it glows
look.dolphin: sleek and grey, leaps out of the water, clicks and whistles, playful
look.nautilus: a swimmer in a great coiled shell, with trailing arms
